label: Test intrinsic pure perfection against merely productive fullness and limitation of esse
summary: See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md#intrinsic-perfection-versus-unrestricted-productive-power-2026-11-24-draft-unreviewed. Distinguish intrinsic real determination from productive virtual possession and substantive higher-mode realization. Reuse #1914 rootUnlimited: nature-based exclusion of an independently classified pure perfection, if it constitutes limitation of esse, contradicts the supplied root under the finite-giver clause. The missing-mode-to-exclusion and exclusion-to-limitation bridges are separate open commitments. The combined bridge can restate fullness by contraposition. Eight local structural variants separate neutral omission, non-contracting essential exclusion and a brute limited root while preserving the same productive witnesses. The preexistence formula survives without intrinsic fullness in the local power-inclusive interpretation of InAct. Registered 64498e7e applies one mode-open IN_ACT_4 predicate uniformly at cause and effect. The tested inventory is restricted to actual witnesses. The historical comparison examines noncognitive life, unity, ontological goodness and active efficacy. The initial challenge of PR #1916 at 35c03763084282b3b33bacf6b4ab274957180cbc reproduced the controls and requested scope repairs. Targeted re-check is pending. Attempt 72a86cf4 records the current scoped assessment.
blocker: A defense of whole-power fullness needs a reason to treat absence of an independently warranted pure OfBeing mode on the same OwnBeing source as a real restriction of its esse. A rival would need to account for the essential exclusion as non-contracting on that same source. Generalization beyond actual witnesses and across the Has/InAct and D/R mappings remains open.
